# CODEx Academy workspace instructions

- Project: Vite vanilla JavaScript frontend prototype.
- Run: `npm install`, then `npm run dev`.
- Build: `npm run build`.
- Keep the CODEx Academy design system consistent: dark navy, green accent, light surfaces, rounded cards, soft shadows, responsive layouts.
- Use Nigerian Naira (₦), Hausa/English labels, and realistic Northern Nigerian examples.
- Preserve client-side routes and reusable data-driven rendering in `src/main.js`.
- Keep production integration boundaries documented in `README.md`: Flask, PostgreSQL, Paystack/Flutterwave, and cloud video storage.
- Do not store raw payment card data.
